questions.question: A box has a bottom layer of 4 rows of 3 cubes and is 2 layers high. Find its volume and explain your method.
questions.expected_answer: The bottom layer has 4 times 3, which is 12 cubes. There are 2 layers, so 2 times 12 is 24. The volume is 24 cubic units.

questions.question: What is the difference between volume and capacity?
questions.expected_answer: Volume is the amount of space an object takes up. Capacity is the amount a container can hold.

questions.question: A box 4 by 3 by 2 and a box 6 by 2 by 2 are packed with cubes. Compare their volumes.
questions.expected_answer: The first box has 12 cubes in a layer and 2 layers, which is 24. The second has 12 cubes in a layer and 2 layers, which is also 24. They have the same volume.
